लोभः [लुभ्-भावे घञ्]
1
Covetousness, avarice, greed, cupidity;
लोभश्चेदगुणेन किं

.
--2 Desire
for, longing after (with gen. or in
comp.); कंकणस्य तु लोभेन

.
--3 Avarice
personified (one of the six enemies of
man).
--Comp.
--अन्वित a. covetous,
greedy, avaricious.
--आत्मन् a.
greedy-minded, avaricious.
--विरहः
absence of avarice;

लोभन a. (नी f.) Alluring,
enticing.
--नं [लुभ्-ल्युट्]
1
Allurement, temptation, seduction,
enticement.
--2 Gold.

लोभनीय, लोभ्य a. Enticing,
alluring, attractive; Ś. 1. 21; 6. 19.

लोभनीय, लोभ्य a. Enticing,
alluring, attractive; Ś. 1. 21; 6. 19.

लोभित p. p. Allured, attracted,
enticed, seduced.

लोभिन् a. (At the end of comp.)
1 Greedy or desirous of, longing for,
eager after.
--2 Alluring, attracting,
enticing.
